# The same UPS four minutes into a power cut: on battery, discharging.
# Written from the protocol docs; not recorded.
> VER
< Network UPS Tools upsd 2.8.2 - https://www.networkupstools.org/
> LIST UPS
< BEGIN LIST UPS
< UPS rack "Rack UPS"
< END LIST UPS
> LIST VAR rack
< BEGIN LIST VAR rack
< VAR rack battery.charge "81"
< VAR rack battery.charge.low "20"
< VAR rack battery.runtime "1860"
< VAR rack battery.type "PbAc"
< VAR rack device.mfr "EATON"
< VAR rack device.model "5P 1550"
< VAR rack driver.name "usbhid-ups"
< VAR rack input.voltage "0.0"
< VAR rack input.voltage.nominal "230"
< VAR rack ups.load "24"
< VAR rack ups.realpower "262"
< VAR rack ups.realpower.nominal "1100"
< VAR rack ups.status "OB DISCHRG"
< END LIST VAR rack
